pair_records.description: Broken: Pauli-Z expectation alone (a scalar observable). Lifted: full Bloch vector (an operator-valued representation).
Broken: a single global scalar summary (support size). Lifted: the per-cell mass profile (m_0, m_1, m_2) -- a localized measure.
Broken: coarse quotient label z only (fibers collapsed). Lifted: (z, x, y) restoring in-fiber coordinates.
Broken: current-step scalar (a static observable). Lifted: the full trajectory (path-space representation).
Broken: affine chart (a, b) (the c = 1 slice). Lifted: homogeneous coordinates (a, b, c) restoring points at infinity.
Broken: point estimate (mean alone). Lifted: ensemble moment vector (mean, variance, skew).
Broken: raw module identity pair (m1, m2) with no protocol tag (composition is ill-defined). Lifted: (m1, m2, family, version) where the tag is the explicit interface.
Broken: gauge-dependent scalar a under translation symmetry. Lifted: gauge-invariant offsets (a, a-b, a-c) making the orbit label recoverable.
